tooltips.code: Stable slug used in API payloads. Unique per tenant. Format: lowercase letters, digits, underscores.
tooltips.isHighValue: Marks the event as a conversion-worthy signal (e.g. eligible for CAPI dispatch). Consumed by downstream modules.
tooltips.tenant: Derived from the first selected team via Tenant.baseUserTeam. Set automatically by the AssignTenantFromTeam hook — assign teams to populate this.
